title: LAN Proxy
summary: Connect Cardputer Zero to a LAN HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy
description:
LAN Proxy connects your Cardputer Zero to an existing HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy on your local network. Enter the address and port once, then press Enter to connect or disconnect. Optional proxy authentication is supported.
The connection stays active when you return to the launcher. A green badge on the app icon shows that the background service is running. Devices on the local network remain directly accessible.
Requires a reachable LAN proxy. Both modes carry IPv4 TCP and DNS. Public IPv6 and general UDP forwarding are unavailable. 

LAN Proxy 可让 Cardputer Zero 使用局域网已有的 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 代理。填写一次地址、端口和可选账号密码，之后按 Enter 即可连接或断开。
返回启动器后，代理继续在后台运行，图标右上角以绿色角标显示运行状态。访问局域网设备仍走直连。
使用前需准备同一局域网内可访问的代理服务。两种模式均转发 IPv4 TCP 和 DNS，公网 IPv6 和普通 UDP 暂不支持。
